description: RegreSSHion: Remote Code Execution vulnerability in OpenSSH server (sshd) due to signal handler race condition.
remediation: Upgrade to OpenSSH 9.8 or later.

description: Terrapin Attack: Prefix truncation attack on SSH Binary Packet Protocol (BPP) allowing message integrity bypass.
remediation: Upgrade to OpenSSH 9.6 or later and disable affected ciphers.

description: Double-free vulnerability in OpenSSH server 9.1 allowing memory corruption.
remediation: Upgrade to OpenSSH 9.2 or later.

description: HTTP/2 CONTINUATION flood vulnerability causing denial of service via memory exhaustion.
remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.59 or later.

description: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Attack allowing denial of service.
remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.58 or later.

description: HTTP request smuggling via mod_proxy when RewriteRule and ProxyPassMatch are used.
remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.56 or later.

description: NULL pointer dereference in HTTP/3 module causing worker process crash.
remediation: Upgrade to nginx 1.25.4 or later.

description: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Attack allowing denial of service.
remediation: Upgrade to nginx 1.25.3 or later.

description: XZ Utils backdoor (liblzma) affecting SSH authentication bypass on certain Linux distributions.
remediation: Downgrade xz-utils to 5.4.x or upgrade to a patched version. Verify system integrity.

description: Remote code execution vulnerability exploitable via specially crafted documents.
remediation: Apply latest Microsoft security updates.

description: Incomplete POST request information disclosure vulnerability.
remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.57 or later.

description: vsftpd vulnerable to denial of service via crafted FTP commands.
remediation: Upgrade to vsftpd 3.0.5 or later.

description: Remote code execution vulnerability in mod_copy module.
remediation: Upgrade to ProFTPD 1.3.8b or later, or disable mod_copy.

description: Privilege escalation vulnerability in MySQL Server component.
remediation: Upgrade to MySQL 8.0.34 or later.

description: Denial of service vulnerability in InnoDB storage engine.
remediation: Upgrade to MySQL 8.0.34 or later.

description: Memory disclosure in aggregate function calls allowing information leakage.
remediation: Upgrade to PostgreSQL 16.1 or the latest minor release.

description: Authenticated remote code execution via specially crafted SORT_RO commands.
remediation: Upgrade to Redis 7.2.4 or later.

description: Heap overflow vulnerability potentially leading to RCE during cluster resharding.
remediation: Upgrade to Redis 7.0.15 or 7.2.4 or later.

description: Server crash due to malformed BSON object in aggregation pipeline.
remediation: Upgrade to MongoDB 7.0.6 or later.

description: TLS certificate validation bypass allowing connection to untrusted servers.
remediation: Upgrade to MongoDB 6.3.2 or 7.0.0 or later.

description: Information disclosure via verbose error messages in certain configurations.
remediation: Upgrade to FileZilla Server 1.8.0 or later.
